messages:
Maya: Heads-up — deploy-bot surfaced inconsistent behavior with tenant pins during v2 rollout. It looks like some edge proxies are dropping our version header. Need a quick tie-break decision. :thinking:

deploy-bot: Canary initiated for `api.v2` at 5%. Pin summary: v1=29 tenants, v2=5 tenants, unpinned=7. Inconsistent header detections: 14 hits in last 10m. Logs: /deploybot/logs/1767.

Tyler: Can we quantify client impact? Are any SDK versions known to strip headers?

kkumar: Our mobile SDK <=1.4.2 normalizes headers to lowercase which should be fine, but older proxy edge (FastEdge v0.9) has a bug where unknown headers are removed under certain routing rules. I flagged two tenants that sit behind that stack.

Priya: For release notes / support, we must be explicit: the X-API-Version header is now canonicalized to `x-api-version` in v2. Customers with intermediate proxies that drop unknown headers may see fallback routing. Drafting support blurb now.

Zach: Telemetry: affected tenants are ~0.6% of write-qps and include one enterprise account (gamma-inc). Their SLA is strict. Recommend safe option.

Maya: Options: 1) Keep current (header-preferred, fallback to feature-flag) 2) Pin-preferred (if tenant has any pin, route to that pinned model) 3) Pause rollout until proxies confirmed. Thoughts?

Tyler: Pick 2) Pin-preferred. Safer for pinned enterprise tenants. We can keep rollout moving for unpinned.

Sara: If we flip to pin-preferred we should add a short line in release notes and a KB entry: "If you have tenant pinning enabled, we will honor pins regardless of header presence during rollout." Also notify #support.

ops_lead (via deploy-bot): Changing pin tiebreak to `pin-preferred` requires toggling config `routing.pin_tiebreak=prefer_pin`. Confirm to proceed.

Maya: Confirmed. ops_lead please flip and run a targeted 10m pinned bake for gamma-inc and one other tenant.

ops_lead: Running: `deploybot config set routing.pin_tiebreak prefer_pin` -> OK. Verifying... `deploybot config get routing.pin_tiebreak` -> "prefer_pin"

ops_lead: Pinning gamma-inc to v1 for 10m: `deploybot pin tenant=gamma-inc target=v1 --expires 10m` -> success. Also pinning demo-tenant-7 for test.

Tyler: Kick off telemetry check: `scripts/tcheck --tenants gamma-inc,demo-tenant-7 --route api.v2 --duration 10m`

Zach: 4m snapshot: gamma-inc errors unchanged, p95 +8ms; demo-tenant-7 steady. No 5xx increase.

Priya: Support blurb posted to #support. Short note: "During the v2 rollout we will honor tenant pins to avoid accidental upgrades when proxies strip version headers. Please contact support if you rely on header routing." Link to KB: /kb/v2-header-guide.

Maya: Good. We'll continue canary at 5% with prefer_pin for 30m observation window. Rollout expansion paused until 30m passes. Guardrails: rollback if pinned-tenant error-rate delta >0.7% (3m) OR global 5xx >1%.

Sara: I'll update release docs and append a troubleshooting section for header-stripping proxies.

deploy-bot: Canary checkpoint OK at +15m. No guardrail breaches.

Zach: 30m check-in: metrics stable. I'll open a follow-up incident if any anomalies appear in the next hour.

Maya: Decision logged: switched to prefer_pin tiebreak, pinned test tenants for 10m, support & docs updated, canary continues at 5% with 30m hold. Revert path: `deploybot config set routing.pin_tiebreak header_preferred` if release owners request.

Tyler: Suggest we add a post-rollout action to add a preflight probe that validates header passthrough from common CDNs. Filing a task in GH: redwood/platform#4281.

Priya: Noted. I'll include migration notes in the changelog for customers who use custom proxies.

Maya: Closing thread — will reopen if ops-bot or deploy-bot fires anything. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
